title: Statifier conformance corpus file
description: One corpus file under conformance/corpus/, holding every case of one suite. Generated by the emitter and never edited by hand (ADR-0070). A file with no cases is a defect, not an empty suite: a suite with no cases has no file. Every case's suite equals the file's suite and case ids are unique across the corpus; the emitter's check enforces both, which this schema cannot express.

suite.description: The suite every case in this file belongs to.

cases.description: The suite's cases, sorted by id.
